Growth; Representatives Sarah Bowman and Colleen Landrum; Representative Jess Ferguson; and Greenfield Mayor Roxanne Hemmingway Hathaway.
During the majority of the public session, commissioners concentrating on items related to COVID-19 relief funds.
A discussion on Highland County Jobs and Family Services' (JFS) request for Fiscal Year 2023 (FY23) Coronavirus Response Funds was brought forward. The FY23 allocation from the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) was directed to the county’s JFS program in the amount of $1.823 million.
From that fund, commissioners approved $640,000 in a previous request and another $1,057,000 three weeks later.
